content:
Alongside macOS 26.6, Apple has simultaneously released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, which include important bug fixes. Details are as follows.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 are finally officially released

After as many as seven release candidates, Apple has finally officially released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

The official versions carry the same build numbers as last week's release candidates:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 (23J620)
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 (24G824)

Apple's release notes only state that these two updates provide "important security fixes" and recommend that all users still on macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia install them.

In recent weeks, Apple has rolled out multiple security fixes for older system versions, many of which patch WebKit vulnerabilities to protect user data. Therefore, if you are still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia, it is recommended to install these updates as soon as possible.

Update: Apple has published the full security content for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, detailing a combined total of over 138 different vulnerabilities across both systems.

Are you still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
